subject: Elara Health - Org gatepass, admin seed & API key scoping
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@elarahealth.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@elarahealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started - Redwood workspace and API keys

Hey Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo today — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We'd like to get into a short onboarding sprint next week to get a POC workspace up and a small number of service accounts for dev + staging. Key asks from our side: 

- A short checklist for initial org setup (projects, roles, policies) so our security team can pre-approve.
- Guidance on scoping API keys/service accounts so we can lock down the minimum privileges.
- A proposed invite cadence: Admins + 3 power users + 6 scoped dev accounts.

Can you send a single plan we can share with our security and infra teams? We have an internal kickoff Wed 6/16 and would like to show a runway.

Appreciate it — Samir

--
Samir Rao
Head of Platform Engineering | Elara Health
samir@elarahealth.com
+1 415-555-0128

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, onboarding@elarahealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started - Redwood workspace and API keys

Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a concise kickoff checklist and an API scope matrix (see attachments). Below is a compact plan you can paste into your kickoff with security: 

1) Org & project layout (day 0)
   - Create one Redwood "Org" for Elara Health (org-id will be provided by us).
   - Projects: dev-elara, staging-elara, prod-elara. Keep prod strictly isolated.
   - Default roles: Org Admin, Project Admin, Power User, Dev (scoped).

2) Initial admin seed & invites (day 0-1)
   - Seed 1 Org Admin (Elara SRE), 2 Project Admins (one dev lead, one security rep).
   - Invite pattern: send admin invites first, then power users, then dev accounts in batches of 3.

3) API keys / service accounts (day 0-2)
   - Create two service accounts: sa-dev (scoped to dev-elara, tokens rotate every 90d), sa-staging (scoped to staging-elara).
   - For long-lived production integration, we recommend short-lived tokens via your CI/CD using our token-exchange endpoint.
   - Scopes we propose: generate-only, inference-read, embeddings-write (see attached CSV for exact permission matrix).

4) Security & compliance handoff (day 1)
   - Provide your security team the attached checklist and the following artifacts: audit log sampling, SOC 2 evidence link, network architecture note.

5) Implementation cadence & ownership
   - Redwood PM (Nikhil) will own the org creation and initial seed.
   - CS lead (Monica) will coordinate invites and session-based admin walkthrough.
   - Infra engineer (Ben) will provide the service-account setup and CI example.

Next steps: I can create the org and seed the admin accounts on Thursday 6/17 at 10:00am PT. If that works for you, we'll push invites and deliver the API key CSV and rotation guidance by EOD 6/17.

Attachments:
 - elara-org-init-checklist.xlsx (org checklist)
 - elara-api-scope-matrix.csv (permission matrix)

Thanks,
Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Implementation Lead, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Elara - admin seed and API key runbook (prep)

Monica / Ben — looping you both in to coordinate the Thursday seed. Samir confirmed the kickoff and wants org creation + invites at 10:00am PT. Key items for us: 

- Monica: run the invite cadence and session. Please prepare the admin walkthrough deck (10-15 min) and be ready to demo invite flow and role assignment.
- Ben: create the two service accounts (sa-dev, sa-staging) in our control plane and pre-generate the keys so we can hand off via secure link. Also prepare a short Jenkins/CircleCI snippet showing token exchange.

Notes:
- Use project naming convention dev-elara/staging-elara/prod-elara to keep Org tidy.
- For prod access we will not issue any long-lived keys; we'll provide admin runbook for on-call.
- I'll create the org and send invites; Monica please send the invite template and Ben will attach the key link to the invite thread (secure doc link).

Attachments referenced in original thread (for your prep): elara-org-init-checklist.xlsx, elara-api-scope-matrix.csv

If either of you have conflicts at 10:00am PT, let me know and I'll push to 11:00.

Thanks — Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma

From: Samir Rao <samir@elarahealth.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@elarahealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started - Redwood workspace and API keys

Thanks Nikhil — that plan looks great and we appreciate the clarity. Thursday 10:00am PT works. A couple of tiny asks before the meeting: 

- Can you scope the sa-dev token to only allow inference-read and embeddings-write? Our security team asked to avoid generate permissions for dev accounts.
- Would you share the secure link to the pre-generated keys in the invite email (we'll have our SRE retrieve and rotate)?

I've pasted a one-line summary you can include in the kickoff doc for leadership: "Goal: Create an Elara Redwood Org with dev/staging/prod projects, seed admins and scoped service accounts to validate latency and embedding workflows within a 1-week POC."

See you Thursday.

Best,
Samir

--
Samir Rao
Head of Platform Engineering | Elara Health
